items.prompt: If the same top-k algorithm rescans every prefix from scratch, how many input visits occur before any heap costs?

options.why: The repeated prefix lengths add to 1+2+...+n, already quadratic.
Earlier values are revisited for each longer prefix.

options.text: At most k visits in total.
options.why: Even a bounded heap must receive every observation in each rescan.
Halving a heap path does not halve the number of prefixes being rescanned.
